name: Castro de Filabres (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, with a zigzag stripe counterchanged along the division.
history: Castro de Filabres applied on 27 October 2004 to register the arms and flag in use, receiving approval in January 2007; the flag is a cloth of 2:3 divided into two equal horizontal stripes, green and yellow, with a dancetty fess of 1/7 counterchanged over the division.

features.role: counterchanged zigzag stripe along the division
